fieldValues.title: When ext:type-inheritance is declared, Package.dependencyRefs must…
fieldValues.normative_statement: When `ext:type-inheritance` is declared, `Package.dependencyRefs` must include a `Reference` for every Type in the transitive closure of base Types for any Type in `Package.types[]`. If `mode === "bundled"`, all such base Types must be present in `types[]`.
